about: Ground heights in metres above the survey datum (20.00 m on the measured survey), on a grid in the site frame: z[i][j] is the ground at (x0 + i * step, y0 + j * step). Made by tools/survey/terrain.py from the points of the photo survey: the lowest points in each cell, with buildings cut out, shrubs planed off and the result tied to the 22 spot levels of the measured survey. Good to a few centimetres on open ground that was filmed on foot; interpolated under trees and behind buildings. The lane beyond the hedge was seen only at the garden gate and is carried along at that level.
